findings.claim: handleDocs joins the attacker-controlled `file` query parameter into a filesystem path with no sanitization and reads it without any containment check, allowing `../` traversal outside docsRoot to read arbitrary process-accessible files.

evidence.note: docsFilePath directly joins attacker-controlled name onto docsRoot with path.join and no normalization, filtering, or containment.
handleDocs takes url.searchParams.get(file) into docsFilePath and fs.readFileSyncs the result, with no call to isWithinRoot and no traversal rejection; 404 only on read failure.
isWithinRoot containment helper is defined but never invoked on the docs path, leaving the traversal check unenforced.

findings.resource: arbitrary server filesystem files readable by the node process
findings.title: Path traversal in /api/docs permits reading files outside docs root
findings.validation: Request GET /api/docs?file=../server.js and encoded variants (e.g. ..%2F) without authentication and observe 200 text/plain with server source, confirming missing containment enforcement.
